scheme_name: Khule Jalsroto Mei Pen Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana
other_conditions: Eligibility limited to groups formed from lessees of the committee in man, chaur, and lake.
benefits_summary: 75% subsidy on the fixed unit expenditure of ₹10,50,000 per pen unit.
documents_required: Photocopy of Photo ID (Aadhaar/Photo ID Card recognized by Govt. of India)
Original copy of Consent Letter (in prescribed format)
Self attested photocopy of Bank Passbook or Cheque (with Bank Name, Branch Name, Account No., IFSC Code)
